detail: Ran under the presidential 'Ensemble!' coalition banner (MoDem) and won the 1st constituency of Savoie (Aix-les-Bains), a seat left open after outgoing deputy Typhanie Degois (LREM) did not seek re-election. First parliamentary mandate.

Re-elected to the National Assembly at the snap legislative elections called after the June 2024 dissolution. HATVP records her deputy mandate resuming in July 2024 and again from December 2024. Precise vote share for this round not confirmed from a primary source consulted.

Elected departmental councillor for the Savoie department and later Vice-President of the departmental council, serving until June 2021 (mandate confirmed in HATVP filing). Precise vote share not confirmed from a primary source consulted.

Long-standing member of the Aix-les-Bains municipal council, including deputy-mayor responsibilities. Mandate continuous through HATVP filing (conseillère municipale since December 2019). Precise per-election vote shares not confirmed from a primary source consulted.
